reviews.author: Madison Smith
reviews.text: Amazing great professional work! we are so thankful D and D auto repairs was able to get our truck in and repaired and paint matched perfectly in a timely manner, just days before our cross country trip after 2 other repair places failed us. so grateful for the amazing work guys!!

reviews.author: Joshua Gibbs
reviews.text: They did a great job on rebuilding my front end and refinishing my roof to make it look new again highly recommend them!

reviews.author: ProtectUrPeace
reviews.text: Best mechanic I have ever been to. Hard to find honest and trust worthy mechanics as a single mom but these guys have gone above and beyond. Got my car back the same day and prices are more then reasonable. Even texted to make sure everything was ok. These guys really care and that means a a lot.

reviews.author: Gary Black
reviews.text: They will never get my business again. They had my truck for over 13 months and only got my cab done and waisted over 3/4 if a gallon of custom mixed paint just on my fire wall. Left my brand new hood out in the weather and it's rusted, over charged me for parts. Got $8000 for maybe $2500-$3000 at the most and that's with me being generous.

reviews.author: Logan Waldron
reviews.text: Look nowhere else but D&D for your mechanical needs. I had the unfortunate circumstance of breaking down while traveling, and Dylan helped me out every step of the way. He was transparent and more than fair. A genuine guy who works hard and has fair prices

reviews.author: Duane Hemingway
reviews.text: The service is friendly, they are excellent in their understanding and knowledge of what you issues are with your vehicle. I have sent a few people there.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: Great customer service and they guy's work quick and tell you every detail that's wrong with your car and what they need to do. Prices are reasonable

reviews.author: Alisha Gray
reviews.text: They went above and beyond for my father who was traveling in his work truck! Can't thank them enough for helping someone mechanically stupid lol! We owe y'all!

reviews.author: shataria mcneill
reviews.text: The communication is awful. I am very displeased with the services here.Also my check engine light came on with new problems the next day and car is running worse then it was before I took it there.
